flash.project_created: Project created. You can now start the first crawl.
flash.project_deleted: Project and all of its crawl data were deleted.
flash.project_busy: A project cannot be deleted while a crawl is running. Stop the crawl first.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.hint: The operation could not be completed. Details were written to the local log file.
errors.not_found: The page or record you are looking for was not found.
errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.disk_full: The disk appears to be full. Free up space in the data directory and try again.
errors.db_locked: The database is busy right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.db_generic: The database could not be accessed. Make sure the data directory is writable.
errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Refresh the page and try again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Crawl websites you own or are authorised to crawl, detect technical SEO issues with evidence, prioritise them and build professional reports.
welcome.f1_text: Internal links, XML sitemaps and robots.txt rules, with optional JavaScript rendering.
welcome.f2_text: Titles, meta, headings, canonicals, indexability, images, structured data, hreflang and more.
welcome.f3_text: CSV and offline-ready HTML reports; change analysis between crawls.
welcome.privacy: All data is stored on this computer. There is no telemetry and no third-party analytics.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Technical SEO status based on each project's most recent crawl.

score.label: Technical SEO health score
score.not_google_long: This score is calculated by Zerqon Spider's documented, deterministic algorithm; it is not an official assessment by Google or any other search engine.

indexability.disclaimer: Technical indexability is derived from the page's signals. Whether Google has actually indexed a page cannot be known without Search Console.

compare.pick_help: Select two scored crawls to compare.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Each project represents one website and its full crawl history.
projects.delete_confirm: This project and ALL of its crawl history will be permanently deleted. Are you sure?
projects.name: Project name
projects.start_url_help: The address the crawl starts from. Scope is derived from its domain.
projects.form_subtitle: Project details and this project's default crawl settings.
projects.history_hint: Old crawls are never deleted; each crawl keeps its own copy of the settings.
projects.no_crawls_title: This project has not been crawled yet
projects.no_crawls_text: Confirm permission and start the first crawl.

settings_form.thresholds_disclaimer: These thresholds are suggested values based on common industry practice; they are not definitive search engine rules.
settings_form.max_depth_help: Link steps from the start page (0 = start page only).
settings_form.concurrency_help: Keep it low to avoid stressing the server (2–5 recommended).
settings_form.delay_ms_help: Shared minimum interval for all workers. A larger robots.txt Crawl-delay takes precedence.
settings_form.max_retries_help: For network errors, 429 and 5xx responses, with exponential backoff.
settings_form.include_subdomains_help: e.g. blog.example.com is treated as internal too.
settings_form.patterns_help: Matched against the full URL. Leave empty for no rule.
settings_form.use_sitemaps_help: Uses Sitemap lines in robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.
settings_form.check_images_help: Sends lightweight requests for internal images to get status and size.
settings_form.allow_localhost_help: Only works when ZERQON_ALLOW_LOCALHOST=true is set in .env; meant for local development sites.
settings_form.render_mode_help: Standard: fast HTTP + HTML. Hybrid: pages that need it are also rendered. JavaScript: every HTML page is rendered in Chromium.

app_settings.title: Application settings
app_settings.subtitle: Data location, appearance and backups.
app_settings.localhost_help: Controlled by ZERQON_ALLOW_LOCALHOST in the .env file.
